title: 苏武慢·雁落平沙
title_en: Su Wu, Slow Tune: Geese Settle on the Flat Sands
author: 蔡伸

form.en: ci, a long lyric in two stanzas

readings.zh: 笼在这里读 lǒng，是“笼罩”的意思。名词“鸟笼”的笼才读 lóng。
readings.en: Here this character is read lǒng, meaning to cover like a veil. It is read lóng when it means a cage.

readings.zh: 尽在这里读 jǐn，是“尽管、任凭”的意思。
readings.en: Here this character is read jǐn, meaning to go on, no matter how long.

glosses.zh: 平沙：水边平坦的沙滩。
glosses.en: píng shā: flat sandy banks by the water.

glosses.zh: 笼：像罩子一样罩住。
glosses.en: lǒng: to cover like a veil.

glosses.zh: 古垒：古代打仗留下的营垒、土墙。
glosses.en: gǔ lěi: old army forts and earth walls from long-ago wars.

glosses.zh: 笳：胡笳，一种吹奏的乐器，声音很悲凉，军中常吹。
glosses.en: jiā: a reed pipe with a mournful sound, often played in army camps.

glosses.zh: 隐隐：模模糊糊，看不太清。
glosses.en: yǐn yǐn: faint and blurry.

glosses.zh: 萧萧：落叶被风吹的声音。
glosses.en: xiāo xiāo: the sound of leaves blown by the wind.

glosses.zh: 天际：天边。
glosses.en: tiān jì: the edge of the sky.

glosses.zh: 暝鸦：黄昏时归巢的乌鸦。暝，天黑。
glosses.en: míng yā: crows flying home at dusk. Míng means dark.

glosses.zh: 片帆：一片船帆，指一只船。
glosses.en: piàn fān: a single sail, that is, one boat.

glosses.zh: 年华将晚：一年快过完了，也指人渐渐老了。
glosses.en: nián huá jiāng wǎn: the year is nearly over, and one is growing old.

glosses.zh: 碧云：青色的云，古诗里常用来表达思念远方的人。
glosses.en: bì yún: blue-green clouds, often used in old poems to stand for missing someone far away.

glosses.zh: 空暮：白白地到了黄昏。
glosses.en: kōng mù: dusk falls in vain.

glosses.zh: 佳人：美好的人，这里指诗人思念的女子。
glosses.en: jiā rén: a lovely person, here the woman the poet misses.

glosses.zh: 俱：都。
glosses.en: jù: both, all.

glosses.zh: 旧游：从前一起游玩的事。
glosses.en: jiù yóu: the times we went out together long ago.

glosses.zh: 邃馆：幽深的房屋。邃，深。
glosses.en: suì guǎn: a deep, quiet house. Suì means deep.

glosses.zh: 朱扉：红色的门。
glosses.en: zhū fēi: red doors.

glosses.zh: 香径：开满花、有香气的小路。
glosses.en: xiāng jìng: a fragrant path lined with flowers.

glosses.zh: 尚：还。
glosses.en: shàng: still.

glosses.zh: 桃花人面：唐代崔护有诗“人面桃花相映红”，写他再去找一位姑娘，门里已经没人了。这里指想念的人见不到了。
glosses.en: táo huā rén miàn: from Cui Hu's Tang poem about a girl's face glowing beside peach blossoms; when he came back, she was gone. Here, a beloved face no longer to be seen.

glosses.zh: 盈：满。
glosses.en: yíng: full.

glosses.zh: 锦轴：用锦缎装裱的卷轴，这里指写满话的信。
glosses.en: jǐn zhóu: a scroll mounted on silk brocade; here, letters full of words.

glosses.zh: 金徽：古琴上用金子做的小圆点，用来标记音的位置，这里指琴。
glosses.en: jīn huī: the gold dots on a qin zither that mark the notes; here, the zither itself.

glosses.zh: 寸心：心。古人认为心只有一寸大小。
glosses.en: cùn xīn: the heart, which people once said was an inch across.

glosses.zh: 幽怨：藏在心里的哀怨。
glosses.en: yōu yuàn: sorrow hidden deep inside.

glosses.zh: 尊：酒杯。
glosses.en: zūn: a wine cup.

glosses.zh: 危阑：高楼上的栏杆。危，高。
glosses.en: wēi lán: the railing of a high tower. Wēi means high.

glosses.zh: 倚遍：每一处栏杆都靠过了，说站了很久。
glosses.en: yǐ biàn: having leaned on every part of the railing; standing there a long time.

glosses.zh: 迟留：停留，久久不走。
glosses.en: chí liú: to linger and not leave.

glosses.zh: 凭仗：依靠，请求。
glosses.en: píng zhàng: to rely on, to ask.

translation.zh: 大雁落在平平的沙滩上，
translation.en: Wild geese settle on the flat sands;

translation.zh: 烟雾笼罩着寒冷的江水。
translation.en: mist veils the cold river.

translation.zh: 古老营垒里胡笳的声音，渐渐断了。
translation.en: From the old fort, the sound of the reed pipe fades away.

translation.zh: 青山模模糊糊，
translation.en: The green hills are faint,

translation.zh: 落叶萧萧地响着，
translation.en: fallen leaves rustle in the wind,

translation.zh: 天边归巢的乌鸦，乱纷纷地飞。
translation.en: and at the sky's edge, crows fly home in a scattered crowd.

translation.zh: 我在楼上，已经是黄昏。
translation.en: Up in the tower, dusk has come.

translation.zh: 一只小船，要走千里的回家路，
translation.en: One small boat has a thousand miles to go home,

translation.zh: 一年又快过完了。
translation.en: and the year is almost over.

translation.zh: 望着青云，天又白白地黑了，
translation.en: I watch the blue clouds as evening falls in vain.

translation.zh: 心上的人在哪里呢？
translation.en: Where is the one I love?

translation.zh: 人和梦都离得那么远。
translation.en: She is far away, and so are my dreams.

translation.zh: 回想从前一起游玩：幽深的房子，红色的门，
translation.en: I remember our old outings: the deep house with its red doors,

translation.zh: 小花园里开满花的小路，
translation.en: the fragrant path in the little garden,

translation.zh: 现在还想着她像桃花一样的脸。
translation.en: and I still think of her face like peach blossoms.

translation.zh: 写满话的信装满了卷轴，
translation.en: My letters fill whole scrolls,

translation.zh: 琴声里也全是离恨，
translation.en: my zither is full of sorrow,

translation.zh: 却还是写不出心里深深的哀怨。
translation.en: yet I still cannot write out the grief deep in my heart.

translation.zh: 我们两地分离，都在发愁，
translation.en: We are in two places, both full of the pain of parting.

translation.zh: 我端着一杯美酒，
translation.en: With a cup of good wine,

translation.zh: 凄凄凉凉地把高楼的栏杆都靠遍了。
translation.en: I lean, lonely, on every part of the tower's railing.

translation.zh: 就这样久久地停留吧，只盼西风
translation.en: So I linger on and on, and ask only the west wind

translation.zh: 把我的泪眼吹干。
translation.en: to dry my tearful eyes.

background.zh: 这首词写一个人在深秋黄昏登楼远望、思念远方心上人的心情。词里有千里归程、两地离愁，可见他正在外漂泊，离家很远。具体写于什么时候、思念的是谁，已经说不清楚了。
background.en: This lyric shows someone climbing a tower at dusk in late autumn, gazing far and missing the one he loves. It speaks of a thousand-mile road home and of sorrow in two places, so he is clearly far from home. When it was written and whom he misses are no longer known.

author_note.zh: 蔡伸（1088—1156），字伸道，号友古居士，北宋末到南宋初的词人，是书法家蔡襄的孙子。他考中过进士，做过地方官。他的词多写离别和相思，语言清丽，感情真挚。
author_note.en: Cai Shen (1088–1156), courtesy name Shendao, also called Yougu Jushi, was a ci poet of the late Northern and early Southern Song. He was a grandson of the famous calligrapher Cai Xiang. He passed the highest civil exam and served as a local official. His lyrics are mostly about parting and longing, in clear, graceful words with true feeling.

appreciation.zh: 上片先画了一幅深秋黄昏的大画：大雁落在沙滩上，烟雾罩着江水，古营垒里传来悲凉的笳声，青山模糊，落叶沙沙响，乌鸦乱飞着回巢。这些景物一个比一个冷清，把人带进孤单的心情里。然后才写楼上的人：路还有千里，一年也快完了，心上人在哪里呢？下片转到回忆，红门、花园、像桃花一样的脸，越美越让人难过。信写满了，琴也弹了，还是说不尽心里的苦。最后他靠遍了栏杆，舍不得走，只好求西风吹干眼泪。从景写到情，情越来越浓，结尾却只是一个小小的动作，让人觉得更加心酸。
appreciation.en: The first stanza paints a wide picture of a late autumn dusk. Geese settle on the sand, mist veils the river, a mournful pipe sounds from an old fort, the hills blur, leaves rustle, and crows scatter home. Each sight is lonelier than the last and draws us into a lonely mood. Only then do we meet the man in the tower. He has a thousand miles to go, the year is nearly done, and where is the one he loves? The second stanza turns to memory: red doors, a garden, a face like peach blossoms. The lovelier the memory, the more it hurts. He has filled scrolls with letters and played his zither, yet still cannot say all his pain. At last he has leaned on every part of the railing and cannot bring himself to leave. He can only ask the west wind to dry his tears. The feeling grows from scene to heart, and the ending is just one small gesture, which makes it all the more moving.
